comparison.objective: Finish installed inserts by breaking and recovering tangs; record measures subfloor flatness and classifies PASS/FAIL.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs coaxial impact manipulation and tiny-fragment recovery; record places a straightedge, probes the deepest gap with a wedge, and reports a measurement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, all tangs contained, and no retained-part damage; record requires a deepest-gap reading within 0.3 mm and the correct tag. Candidate fracture thresholds are not quantified.
comparison.reason: Measurement and classification test reference placement and probing, not fracture mechanics or debris control.
